exercises.name: Wyciskanie na ławce poziomej w suwnicy Smitha

scenes: Abdominal floor crunch, supine on mat with bent knees, shoulders slightly raised and arms crossed over chest.
Hanging knee raise on overhead pull-up bar, knees bent toward chest.
Seated chest press machine, back supported, handles at chest height pushed forward.
Pec deck chest fly machine, seated back supported, arms closing in front of chest.
Incline BARBELL bench press on a 30-degree incline bench, bar above upper chest.
Flat barbell bench press in SMITH machine, horizontal bench and bar guided on two vertical rails.
